pages.text: The $(l)Arrow Tower$() is a stationary unit providing consistent long-range support and high resilience to hazards.

pages.title: Tower Statistics
pages.text: $(li)$(6)Health:$() 20$(li)$(6)Armor:$() 5$(li)$(6)Damage:$() 4-5 per Arrow$(li)$(4)Immunities:$() Fire, Poison$(li)$(4)Range:$() Medium$(br2)Fires at $(b)medium speed$() to maintain a defensive perimeter.

pages.title: Ammunition System
pages.text: You can $(b)load or replace$() any arrow type.

pages.title: Infinite Ammo
pages.text: Tired of reloading? You can apply an $(b)any Enchanted Books$() to the tower. This grants it $(5)infinite arrows$(), ensuring it never runs out of ammunition during a siege.
